Hi Amy, Lina, Devon —

Thanks again for agreeing to a short joint office-hours session where we can walk through Redwood Inference for your respective evaluation teams. To keep this efficient we're proposing a 90-minute block where each company gets a focused 25-minute slot (20min demo + 5min q/a), with a 15-minute buffer for cross-company questions and host handoffs.

Proposed cadence (Thu Nov 16):
- 16:00–16:25 PT — Acme Analytics (Amy)
- 16:30–16:55 PT — NovaRetail (Lina)
- 17:00–17:25 PT — ZephyrCloud (Devon)
- 17:25–17:40 PT — cross-company Q&A and next steps

We plan to rotate hosts internally so you get both a product and an infra perspective: Marissa will lead the first slot, Ben will take the second, and I'll cover the third.

Action items:
- Reply with any conflicts (we can slide 30m earlier or later).
- If you want a custom demo focus (latency, private deployment, or cost optimization), say which slot and we'll tailor the deck.

Attaching a draft agenda and a calendar stub — I can send separate invites once times are confirmed.

Thanks,
